description: This file defines the enyo loader system, including path resolution, package management, and script/module loading mechanisms for the Enyo framework.

classes.name: enyo.pathResolverFactory
classes.description: Factory class for resolving and rewriting paths with macros.

classes.name: enyo.loaderFactory
classes.description: Loader class responsible for managing package, module, stylesheet, and design metadata loading.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a path alias to the resolver.

methods.name: addPaths
methods.description: Adds multiple paths to the resolver.

methods.name: includeTrailingSlash
methods.description: Ensures a path ends with a slash.

methods.name: rewrite
methods.description: Replaces macros in a path with their mapped values.

methods.name: loadScript
methods.description: Loads a script via the machine object.

methods.name: more
methods.description: Processes a dependency block, handling asynchronous loading.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes package loading and triggers finish callbacks.

methods.name: continueBlock
methods.description: Continues processing dependencies in a block.

methods.name: require
methods.description: Processes a dependency path, determining its type and loading accordingly.

methods.name: getPathPrefix
methods.description: Determines the prefix for a given path based on its format.

methods.name: decodePackagePath
methods.description: Decodes package path into alias, target, folder, and manifest.

methods.name: aliasPackage
methods.description: Creates an alias for a package based on its path.
